practical: Review of theoretical concepts via PPT; No hands-on practical activity; Instructor supervision required for Q&A
intro_questions: What are the four main branches of ballistics?
Name the primary forces acting on a projectile in flight.
Define the term 'stability' in the context of rocket flight.

development.content:
Introduction to Ballistics
Internal Ballistics
External Ballistics
Terminal Ballistics
Trajectory types

Thrust Force
Weight Force
Drag Force
Lift Force
Equation of motion

Longitudinal Stability
Lateral Stability
Spin Stabilization
Aerodynamic Center
Center of Gravity

summary_questions: Explain how the center of gravity affects rocket stability.
Describe the role of drag force during the terminal phase of flight.
Differentiate between spin stabilization and aerodynamic stabilization.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how wind conditions affect bomb ballistics as covered in LP 06.
